title: Add Ring Stories and Detail Panel Integration
description: Create Ring/Orb storybook stories and integrate Ring component into sketchpad Type detail panel ConnectorsListSection.
summary: Ring replaces Slider for connector t in Type detail panel. ConnectorsListSection shows all connectors as draggable orbs on shared Ring. ConnectorSection shows single-orb Ring. Per-connector Slider for t removed. Stories created for Orb and Ring. Build passes, 14 tests green.
